name: PowerShell
description: Installs PowerShell (pwsh) from the self-contained Linux tarball, which bundles its own .NET runtime, plus PSScriptAnalyzer. Pairs with the ms-vscode.PowerShell extension, whose linting runs PSScriptAnalyzer inside a real pwsh host.

version.description: Version of PowerShell to install. "latest" resolves the newest stable tag at build time; give an exact version to pin.

installPSScriptAnalyzer.description: Also install PSScriptAnalyzer system-wide, so Invoke-ScriptAnalyzer works from the shell and in pre-commit, not only inside the editor.

includeCompatibilityProfiles.description: Keep PSScriptAnalyzer's compatibility_profiles, 279 MB of JSON describing the API surface of Windows PowerShell versions. Only the PSUseCompatible* rules read them, and those emit nothing unless you configure target profiles, so this is off by default. Turn it on if you lint for cross-version Windows compatibility.

useInvariantGlobalization.description: Run .NET with invariant globalization and drop libicu, saving 36 MB. Linting and the language server are unaffected, but Install-Module stops working and culture-aware formatting falls back to the invariant culture. Rarely worth it -- libicu is the small part of this feature.
